newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT shares down on BT-MCI merger.
newsitem.headline: NTT shares down on BT-MCI merger.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's shares were down by midday on Tuesday, depressed by news that British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Communications Corp were merging to create a powerful new rival, brokers said.
At midday, the shares were down 7,000 yen at 780,000 yen.
The largest transatlantic deal in history will create the second largest telecommunications company in the world after AT&T Corp of the United States, ousting NTT from its position as the number two.
Analysts say there are fears that NTT is lagging behind its global rivals as the firm's privatisation programme has stalled due to government indecision.
